transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I sign Thursday's airlift manifest, I need to confirm whether operations, signal, and medical have any changes to their standard pallet requests. As a reminder, the contracted aircraft has capacity for exactly 23 pallets, and our normal weekly request totals 18 pallets — 8 engineering, 5 communications batteries, and 5 medical supplies — leaving 5 unused spaces. If any of you have changes to your standard requests, please report them now so I can finalize the manifest and loading instructions.
